name: Kozilek's spawn
description: Eldrazi with black glass shards that fill the caves, including a dead heap discarded in a chamber.

timeline.summary: Ob Nixilis uses spawn of Kozilek to cut Nissa off from Zendikar and the leylines.
timeline.quote: She was cut off from Zendikar. Powerless.

timeline.summary: Following a strange current, Jori and Kiora swim into a cliff and are dragged through a rift, a Kozilek spawn guarding the way until the crevasse collapses on it.
timeline.quote: All at once, the crevasse collapsed in on itself and the Eldrazi

timeline.summary: Jori finds a chamber piled with dead Kozilek spawn and a shaft leading up.
timeline.quote: But the Eldrazi were not moving. They were all dead.

pages_say.description: Eldrazi spawn of Kozilek that Ob Nixilis borrows to cut Nissa off from Zendikar.
Eldrazi with black glass shards that fill the caves, including a dead heap discarded in a chamber.
